checkpoint.summary: The exact Rust codec separates realized palettes from witnessed functional-root proposals. Shipped Mozart K330-I/K331-I strict joint root/core agreement remains 63.04% / 55.93%. The maintained four-work quality readout plus independently witnessed function-span continuation reaches 93.03% / 93.75% joint, 93.81% / 94.14% core and 98.44% / 98.26% root agreement. Original windows, surface cores and immediate native proofs stay immutable; the additional .75 quarter in K331 uses a separately scoped pair proof and numeric inversion witnesses. The teacher has known Mozart training overlap: these are development experiments, not shipped inference or independent validation. Requested 100% remains unmet; strict denominators and observations stay fixed and no holdout is parsed.
nextActions: Close realized-core and boundary errors jointly. Atomic source frames plus explicit pitched-silence holds can represent 100% of supported reference timing; this oracle says nothing about selecting labels. Remaining surface errors include absent suspended-third vocabulary and poorly ranked implied/seventh members. Do not freeze the decoder's selected windows or alter the strict denominator.

Retain the reproducible four-work pretrained quality-readout control. Joint degree/quality correction, direct function supervision and the six-work quality fit underperform; no per-work oracle selection or further blind head sweeps. K283-III improves both works but repairs none of their I(64) replacements. More examples alone do not resolve this output-structure gap.

Evaluate the five-coefficient physical proposer under a separately fitted surface selector. It passes sustained/broken replacement, KEEP and changed-parent controls, and selected operations compile exact originals plus changed-domain realizations. Parent/key/quality priors stay fixed; incompatible parents and unsupported syntax remain unlabelled for operations. Fit surface selection against actual training core likelihood, preserving UNKNOWN and strict denominators; never interpret that selector as relationship confidence.

Use the maintained --function-spans research condition for bounded continuation. Source/capture-admitted selected numeric inversion, identical intermediate realizations, observed bass and a native proof on the explicit endpoint pair are all required. Keep original immediate proofs and independent surfaces intact; direct-to-tonic and changing-bass cases remain unresolved.

Require continuity, independent seventh, ambiguity and track-repartition controls when changing scoring. Missing members can be implied by surrounding harmony; passing/neighbor motion can be structurally chordal. These musical distinctions constrain any learned or hand-written proposal.

Preserve an edited composition program independently of reanalysis. Keep source observations, authored parameters and inferred evidence distinct; a new inverse reading must not erase an authored dependency.
After representation/ranking choices are frozen, evaluate held-out work lineages once, alongside exact reconstruction, useful edits, runtime and explanatory cost.
